html:
Remark. Gravity as emergent substrate geometry

In the QOU framework, general relativity emerges as the substrate geometry of the CR manifold (GR substrate geometry). The quantum-weighted stress-energy tensor T_{\mu\nu}^{(q)} introduces q-dependent corrections to the Einstein field equations. This formally realises gravity as an information-theoretic phenomenon.
